name: Başlık — EUR/TRY kuru canlı API'den yüklenir

planSteps.description: Navigate to https://soncagstock.vercel.app/ and log in with the project's configured username and password (click 'Giriş Yap'), wait until the header text 'Sonçağ Stok · Dashboard' is visible, then wait 5 seconds
The header EUR widget shows '€1 =' followed by a numeric value greater than 0 (not the placeholder '--') and the '₺' symbol
Click the refresh icon button inside the EUR widget and wait 3 seconds
The EUR value is still a number greater than 0 and no error toast is shown
